from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityEnrollment(BaseModel):
    """Enrollment data for one university from a CDS report."""
    university: str | None = Field(description="Name of the university as named in the document")
    undergraduate_count: int | None = Field(description="Total number of undergraduate students")
    graduate_count: int | None = Field(description="Total number of graduate students")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    university_enrollments: list[UniversityEnrollment]
